name: No player appears in both teams' starting lineups
description: When the per-match lineups artifact is fetched, the set of home starting player names and the set of away starting player names are disjoint, so no single player is fabricated into both lineups at once.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match-lineups/<first-id>.json using the captured id
Collect the player names from home.starting_xi into one set and from away.starting_xi into another set
Verify the home starting player name set and the away starting player name set share zero common names
